Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Secure Storage Solutions, LLC operates a clean and well-maintained self-storage facility with a range of unit sizes for both personal and business use. Our facility is equipped with a state-of-the-art security system, including 24/7 video surveillance, electronic access control, and regular security patrols. We conduct routine maintenance checks and adhere to proactive pest control measures, ensuring a safe and secure environment for our tenants. We do not allow the storage of perishable goods, live animals, or high-risk hazardous materials, maintaining compliance with underwriting guidelines. Our operations are focused on providing accessible, secure, and reliable storage solutions to meet diverse customer needs.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, Secure Storage Solutions, LLC experienced a water leak from a faulty plumbing fixture affecting three storage units. The leak caused property damage valued at $2,500. The claim has been settled, and repairs were completed by April 10, 2023. No further action is needed on this loss. In addition, on July 22, 2023, a minor vandalism incident occurred in which two units had their locks tampered with, resulting in no theft or damage. The cost of repairs was approximately $500. This incident has been closed with no further claims anticipated.
